text.en: A great Tamil epic where compassion feeds the hungry.

Manimegalai is one of the five great Tamil epics (ஐம்பெருங்காப்பியங்கள்), composed by Seethalai Saathanaar. It is the story of Manimegalai, the daughter of Kovalan and Madhavi, who leaves her dancing family's life and becomes a Buddhist nun.
The epic is known for its message of charity and service. Manimegalai receives the Amuthasurabi, an inexhaustible bowl that always gives food, and she uses it to feed the hungry.
Learn the terms காப்பியம் (epic), பெருங்காப்பியம், அமுதசுரபி (the bowl of plenty) and பசிப்பிணி (the disease of hunger). It is a memorisation poem in the book.
